[SWS_PER_00409]
⌈
When ara::core::Deinitialize is called, the
Persistency shall implicitly ensure that all open files of all File Storages are
persisted as though fsync was called, and that not persisted values in all Key-Value
Storages are dropped as though DiscardPendingChanges was called.
After-
wards, all access structures shall be freed.
⌋
